Incidentally three other walkers competed with distinction; Ed Shillabeer was 3rd, Arthur Eddlestone 4th and Stephen Till 6th. Congratulations also to John Keown on completing 25 consecutive ' Brightons ' 1300 Miles !!!!

Winner was Carl Lawton making a return to form over the longer distances and John Dunsford also having one of his better races for a while. 1.C.Lawton 8:05.35; 2.P.Owen (Royal Sutton) 8:20.05; 3.S.Till 8:24.08; 6.J.Dunsford 8:46.31.
